QuestInfo.name: II: Odd Lady
QuestInfo.0: You realized the prime minster of Commerci, #b#p9390203##k, didn't trust you. You needed to find a way to gain his trust if you wanted to establish peaceful relations with Commerci, so you went on a mission to secure land routes with #b#p9390202##k, #p9390203#'s son. Leon was tricked by the Delfino, and now all hope looked lost.
